scope: One removable T08 wings then T07 body export experiment; no production/default/CI changes
writes: Only a new output directory whose parent already exists; never nest it in the original bound project

output.group-plan.json: Immutable unvalidated candidate plan; all returned paths are relative to its directory
output.project/: 109 original payload files copied byte-for-byte plus two experiment files; no media/cache/out
output.project/gfx/group_T08_T07_0000_3600.html: 1920x1080 transparent single HTML export; ?f=global_frame; valid half-open global frame domain [0,3600)
output.project/runtime/group-pilot.js: Calls original bound renderFrame separately per active member, in paint order

mapping.inactive_members: No renderFrame invocation; empty member SVG root

barriers: Original members are adjacent plain full-size GFX overlays at paintIndex 6 and 7; any timeline drift is rejected
Each member retains its own SVG root, viewBox, original fragment, defs, masks, effects, opacity and camera
film-T08-01-* and film-T07-01-* original namespaces and all references are preserved; no ID rewrite
Original bundle and mount options are retained; no shared-state optimization, asynchronous resource change or effect removal
Exactly one f query is accepted; invalid frames reject rather than clamp
Initial visible error plate is hidden only after complete synchronous render; script failure is not transparent success
NAVFREE, BeginFrame, canvas-export and static-spans are not enabled

cache.content_identity: Includes ordered windows/options, all 109 bound payload hashes, generated page/adapter hashes and implementation dependencies
cache.environment: Runner must include actual browser/tool revisions, renderer implementation and effective pixel-affecting options
cache.helper: prepare.cache_identity(plan, actual_renderer_environment_sha256) binds whole plan and environment
cache.namespace: Independent experiment arm only; no old PNG reuse or production completion marker

runner_responsibility: Verify all frozen input and candidate bytes before and after the run, record actual candidate commit/tree and environment
Call original render_page with explicit frame list at 1920x1080 and one tab; global IDs map directly to group query/output IDs
Keep baseline member global-to-local mapping and member half-open activation; do not render T08 before global 18
Use original bound project for full N1 paper/other-GFX/native-subtitle reference; copied experiment has no full-film media
Compare lossless RGBA and alpha, black/white/actual backgrounds and full original N1 composition without loosening thresholds
Own rendering budget, timing, cancellation, cleanup, output verification and all promotion decisions
coverage_limit: Explicit local structural/filesystem tests only; no CI discovery/registration change, browser/pixel/performance/whole-film qualification or independent review is inferred
rollback: Do not select this experiment. Original 19 entries and timeline remain unchanged; discard only the newly owned experiment output after preserving evidence.
incremental_edit_limit: The fixed input pin intentionally rejects changed original content. Local-edit cost experiments require a separately frozen amended input manifest and review; this preparer does not silently accept variants.
qualification: UNVALIDATED_CANDIDATE; browser internal composition and original FFmpeg overlays may differ in alpha/color/rounding even when each member fragment is identical
